nodes.name: Palla Entry Point
nodes.description: Delhi entry point with baseline freshwater quality upstream of urban sewage drains.

nodes.name: Jagatpur Reach
nodes.description: Upstream agricultural floodplain reach before urban river containment.

nodes.name: Wazirabad Barrage Upstream
nodes.description: Raw drinking water abstraction point for Delhi water treatment plants.

nodes.name: Wazirabad Barrage Downstream
nodes.description: Immediate downstream of barrage; almost zero fresh river flow released during non-monsoon periods.

nodes.name: Najafgarh Drain Outfall
nodes.description: Major pollution inflow accounting for ~60% of total sewage/wastewater discharges into the river.

nodes.name: ISBT Kashmere Gate
nodes.description: Urban channel reach heavily loaded with domestic sewage and runoff.

nodes.name: Old Railway Bridge (Loha Pul)
nodes.description: Historic landmark gauging site; continuous organic load and elevated turbidity.

nodes.name: Geeta Colony / Shantivan
nodes.description: Central river corridor with substantial domestic and industrial outfalls.

nodes.name: ITO Barrage Upstream
nodes.description: Stagnant urban pool behind ITO Barrage gates with severe algal blooms.

nodes.name: Delhi Gate Drain Outfall
nodes.description: Heavy untreated domestic wastewater and industrial effluent outfall.

nodes.name: Barapullah / Nizamuddin Reach
nodes.description: Third largest drain outfall carrying sewage from South Delhi and satellite colonies.

nodes.name: DND Flyway Reach
nodes.description: Broad meandering section characterized by persistent black-sludge deposition.

nodes.name: Okhla Barrage Upstream
nodes.description: Upstream of Okhla Barrage with thick foam mats and excessive surfactant concentrations.

nodes.name: Kalindi Kunj / Bird Sanctuary
nodes.description: Site of toxic white froth during winter and post-monsoon seasons.

nodes.name: Okhla Barrage Downstream
nodes.description: Inflow of Shahdara drain carrying heavy untreated industrial and urban effluents from East Delhi.

nodes.name: Jaitpur Reach
nodes.description: Dense informal settlements and industrial discharges from Okhla Industrial Area.

nodes.name: Madanpur Khadar
nodes.description: Confluence with Tughlakabad drain system carrying chemical and dye industry effluents.

nodes.name: Shahdara Confluence & Asgarpur
nodes.description: Yamuna leaves NCT Delhi into Uttar Pradesh; peak cumulative chemical and organic pollution.
